title: Share a service
summary: NestJS: Share a service. Change the service title.
introduction: A provider is a shared helper supplied by Nest. The controller asks for Books in its constructor. Open GET /book.

blocks.text: Create a practice project with npx @nestjs/cli new school. Replace src/main.ts with one complete example and run npm run start. Use http://127.0.0.1:3000. The original app files are unused by these small examples.

blocks.title: Share a service

blocks.text: The module creates Books as a provider. Constructor injection gives the same helper to the controller.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: List Books in module providers so Nest can create it.
